description: Puntos de acceso a internet gratuitos habilitados (PAIG) is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Comisión Federal de Electricidad (CFE). Conjunto de aquellos puntos de acceso a internet gratuitos habilitados que iniciaron operación en el mes de enero 2026. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Comisión Federal de Electricidad (CFE). Its tags are acceso información, cobertura red, competencia digital, gobierno digital, internet. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-03-13 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
